leonart.title: Technical Lead & Project Manager
leonart.description: Leon'Art was a platform connecting artists and art enthusiasts, facilitating the sale and purchase of artworks. This web and mobile application distinguished itself from other online art sales platforms through its social network dimension, promoting the discovery of lesser-known artists. Co-founded with 6 other students, we successfully launched a beta version before deciding to discontinue as we evolved as individuals and realized we didn't see a future for the product.
achievements: Led technical development as backend developer and project manager
Successfully delivered complex commercial product with full payment integration
Implemented social network features promoting artist discovery
Managed development team and coordinated project milestones
Deployed scalable infrastructure using Docker and Kubernetes
Integrated comprehensive API documentation with Swagger
leonart.impact: Successfully launched a complete commercial platform that connected artists with art enthusiasts, demonstrating end-to-end product development capabilities.
